name: The Great Tonic
pitch: A physician who never strikes back: your own blows are forced into your meridians until you burst, and the empty cannot take tonic.

new.name: Feeding-Back Ward
new.effect: A per-hit ward that also returns blocked damage to the attacker's linh lực, 1.0 per point; past their maximum it becomes Surfeit.

new.name: Strong Decoction
new.effect: +0.3 to the share a ward returns.

new.name: Fine Needling
new.effect: +20 points to arts with the needle form.

new.name: Pill-Fed
new.effect: +1 % return per point of the attacker's pill toxicity, up to +30 %.
new.second_home: a poisoner who works on toxicity

new.name: Deep Abscess
new.effect: Surfeit the cap clips adds to the next Lancing, up to +15 % of health.

new.name: Self-Cure
new.effect: When a target ruptures, regain 10 % of maximum health.

new.name: Hundred Vessels Canon
new.effect: Main, Địa giai, Wood and Water. A dosing manual that treats only what travels the channels, so it has no answer to poison or the soul.

new.name: Lancing
new.effect: With Surfeit above 60 %: target loses 25 % of maximum health per 100 % of Surfeit, past ward, guard and evade; its pool and Surfeit go to 0.

new.name: Swollen Channels
new.effect: Sealed, Water, size 8. Wards and how force moves through them. Notable: Strong Decoction.

new.name: Life, Tonic branch
new.effect: Health and regeneration lines, Pill-Fed, keystone Deep Abscess, and an art node for Lancing.

new.name: Surfeit
new.effect: Linh lực forced into a full pool, held as a share of qi_max up to 100 %. A forced gain is at most the pool the target holds, so the empty cannot take tonic.

questions: Is giving an enemy linh lực as a threat a direction for wards in general, or one sect's secret?
